phase: the delegation committed and nothing was killed (the control)
detail: Control: the same run with no kill. The process was left alone once a specialist held control; it served every turn itself, reported the holders return_agent -> refund_agent -> order_agent -> return_agent, and ended with return_agent holding control. No second process existed, so the recovery in the fault run — and where it landed — is attributable to the kill and not to the shape of the run.
